**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Memory 2.0 (#864): ship Wave 0 (#870 memory:audit, #820 hydration guard) and Wave 1's #863 backend-contract ruling, each through the cold-review circuit.

## Instructions
- Records are the concept; engram is an adapter (ADR-0002, ADR-0017:13). Agnosticism test: does it hold under MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles?
- Agents draft, humans promote: brain/core and brain/project are Tier 2/3; drafts go under openspec/changes/<change>/brain-drafts/ and the maintainer runs brain:promote (TTY + typed word).
- Run brain:review BEFORE announcing a PR; wait until gh pr checks shows ≥9 registered checks and none pending, or the verdict is a transient REVISE.
- Slice PRs: Closes #<slice> + "Parent: #864" in prose, never a closing keyword against the epic.
- Never add Co-Authored-By; conventional commits with (#N).

## Discoveries
- Landing time must be read on the first-parent line (git log -m --first-parent --diff-filter=A); the epic's opening p50 10.9 h was optimistic — 21.6 h real.
- Two lock-file atomicity bugs found by cold review + a real multi-process test: mkdir+write is not atomic (use staged dir + rename); rmSync in place leaves an empty dir a rename can replace (release = rename aside + verify + rm). Reclaim must be verified. Orphan sweep only on the contended path.
- A draft's body-end value is also a literal heading later in the draft — never anchor an insertion on its first occurrence.
- brain:promote has only two shapes (new ADR, in-place amendment); a NEW methodology doc promotes manually.
- The cold-review poster (#851 §3.1) is the contract's second producer; it needs a declared write target (invoking checkout, never /tmp/brain-review-<sha>) and is gated on lane collector 3.1a; validateRecord refuses type 'review' until memory-format's enum is promoted.

## Accomplished
- PR #871 (#870 memory:audit) merged; baseline on #864; finding on #738.
- PR #872 (#820 hydration guard) merged: atomic acquire/release, verified reclaim, 6-process test (held 30 / refused 120 / 0 overlaps).
- PR #875 (#863 ruling) APPROVE at 74d56cd0, 9 gates green — six drafts in brain-drafts/ (contract doc, ADR-0002 A1, ADR-0004 A1, harness-contract, agent-authorities, consolidation §3), all planned OK via planAmendment; epic re-sequenced (2.3 → 3.2 → 2.4), 1.2a heal added, 0.0/1.2 ticked; #874 filed (record-first, task 3.2); note on #851.

## Next Steps
- Maintainer: merge #875; promotion sitting for the six drafts (copy contract manually + brain:promote ×5, one signing commit).
- Wave 1 remaining: #862 (lane ruling) — explore + proposal, same shape as #863.
- Wave 2 after rulings: #805, #738, #247, 2.5, 1.2a (file the heal ticket).
- Worktrees for merged slices (864/870/820) still present; clean when asked.

## Relevant Files
- openspec/changes/issue-863-backend-contract/{explore,proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md + brain-drafts/*
- openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/{tasks,design}.md — waves, dependencies
- brain/scripts/memory/lib/hydration-guard.mjs, audit.mjs, audit-io.mjs; backends/engram.mjs importMemory
- brain/scripts/lib/amendment-draft.mjs (planAmendment), brain/scripts/brain-promote.mjs
